decision: opened the form builder spike on feat/form-builder-spike
why: the brief is a multi-part prototype the lead reviews later

decision: skipped a second design bakeoff and kept the brief's .ui model, command log, and live canvas
why: those decisions are already made, and another arena would only reopen them

decision: one writer owns the form tree
why: the document, commands, and canvas all mutate one tree, so parallel editors would race

decision: omit a property only when it has no stdset and its body matches a small default table
why: Designer files keep dynamic properties with stdset="0", and the FreeCAD corpus round-trip failed when those were dropped

decision: structural edits patch layout membership instead of rebuilding the form
why: a full rebuild of the 302-widget sample was about 50 ms, over the 16 ms edit budget

decision: the geometry index refreshes on the next pointer event, not inside the edit timer
why: walking every widget on each edit cost about 22 ms, and mouse moves only need the cached rects

decision: the overlay is a child of the view, mapped from host coordinates
why: an overlay inside the graphics proxy painted under the real widgets, so insertion lines and badges were hidden

decision: wrap and unwrap use the physical Control key
why: the brief names Ctrl+G, and on macOS Command is already copy, paste, undo, and save

decision: wrote DESIGN.md before rebuilding the UI and kept the plumbing
why: the owner asked for the most care on UI, and the command log, writer, and generator were already verified

decision: the chrome style sheet is set on builder windows, never on the application, and the form gets an explicit runtime palette
why: an app-level sheet restyled canvas widgets (a squeezed scrollbar looked like spin arrows on Notes) and the dark chrome turned the form dark

decision: Hug, Fill and Fixed are written as size policy plus min equals max; returning to the class default deletes the lines
why: pain 2 asks for words, and Designer files must stay standard

decision: resize handles exist only on the right, bottom and corner and write Fixed sizes
why: the layout owns position, so left and top handles would promise pixel geometry the file cannot keep

decision: reconcile compares one signature per container and moves live widgets
why: wrap, unwrap and first layout used to rebuild the subtree; moving keeps widget identity and cost

decision: removed the per-widget Python event filter and free replaced forms at once
why: the filter cost about 20 ms per open on 302 widgets; deferred deletes never ran under nested processEvents, RSS grew to +30 MB

decision: tab order and buddies are overlays with an Esc banner; connections live in the inspector
why: pain 13 and 20: no sticky modes, and a way out is always on screen

decision: FreeCAD Gui:: widgets are created through FreeCADGui.UiLoader with the Qt base class as fallback
why: uic itself emits no import for Gui:: classes, so the old output could not run
